billing_budget_target_check.name: billing_budget_target_check
billing_budget_target_check.value:
case "billing_budget"."scope"
        when 'member_default' then "billing_budget"."user_id" is null and "billing_budget"."project_id" is null and "billing_budget"."api_key_id" is null and "billing_budget"."amount_cents" is not null
        when 'user' then "billing_budget"."user_id" is not null and "billing_budget"."project_id" is null and "billing_budget"."api_key_id" is null
        when 'project' then "billing_budget"."user_id" is null and "billing_budget"."project_id" is not null and "billing_budget"."api_key_id" is null and "billing_budget"."amount_cents" is not null
        when 'api_key' then "billing_budget"."user_id" is null and "billing_budget"."project_id" is null and "billing_budget"."api_key_id" is not null and "billing_budget"."amount_cents" is not null
      end

hook_endpoint_disabled_check.name: hook_endpoint_disabled_check
hook_endpoint_disabled_check.value: "hook_endpoint"."enabled" = ("hook_endpoint"."disabled_reason" is null) and ("hook_endpoint"."disabled_reason" is null) = ("hook_endpoint"."disabled_at" is null)

inbox_message_source_check.name: inbox_message_source_check
inbox_message_source_check.value: ("inbox_message"."direction" = 'inbound' and "inbox_message"."received_email_id" is not null and "inbox_message"."email_id" is null) or ("inbox_message"."direction" = 'outbound' and "inbox_message"."email_id" is not null and "inbox_message"."received_email_id" is null)

push_notification_collapse_sent_idx.name: push_notification_collapse_sent_idx
push_notification_collapse_sent_idx.where: "push_notification"."collapse_key" IS NOT NULL AND "push_notification"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL

sign_signer_email_due_idx.name: sign_signer_email_due_idx
sign_signer_email_due_idx.where: "sign_signer"."delivery" = 'email' and ("sign_signer"."notified_at" is null or "sign_signer"."next_reminder_at" is not null or "sign_signer"."remind_requested_at" is not null or ("sign_signer"."status" = 'signed' and "sign_signer"."copy_sent_at" is null))
